messages:
darren_incidentbot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Elevated downstream fanout detected from kv-cache shard group 'us-east-1-a' — storage RPS ~5x baseline, router 504s increasing. Paging mike_oncall and alice_sre.

mike_oncall: on it, thanks. grabbing timeline and current SLOs.

alice_sre: I see the spike correlated with a change in prefix grouping rules 27m ago. Potential hot fanout for some tenant prefixes.

ben_runtime: confirming — recent rollout disabled per-prefix aggregation for latency reasons. That could increase backend fanout for many small prefixes.

cathy_ml: any evidence of correctness issues (i.e., cache misses causing incorrect reads) or is this purely load?

alice_sre: primarily load. 95th latency to storage is up, but errors are 504/timeout, not correctness. Still, we should prepare a bypass if needed for correctness-sensitive tenants.

mike_oncall: mitigation plan: 1) apply temporary fanout limiter at routing layer to cap per-prefix fanout; 2) re-enable aggregation for high-card prefixes as fallback; 3) open comms for impacted customers. Who can flip the limiter now?

ben_runtime: I can push a route-level limiter. Pushing an emergency patch to route-config now. Command:
```
POST /admin/route-limiter/apply
{ "target": "kv-route-group-us-east-1-a", "mode": "per-prefix", "max_fanout": 8 }
```

ben_runtime: deploying in 2..1.. live.

system: deploy-bot: route-limiter v0.9.1 deployed to us-east-1-a (canary 20%)

alice_sre: monitoring metrics — initial drop in storage RPS by ~30% in canary slice. Good signal. Rolling to 100% in 60s.

mike_oncall: rolling limiter to 100% now.

cathy_ml: should we also re-enable prefix aggregation for top 10 hot prefixes? I can patch grouping for those tenants to restore prefix folding.

ben_runtime: do it. patch:
```
PATCH /admin/prefix-grouping
{ "buckets": ["tenant:acme:*", "tenant:zenith:*"], "mode": "aggregation" }
```

ben_runtime: patch applied.

emma_support: heads up — Support triage: 12 customers flagged with elevated tail latency. Drafting email to impacted customer contacts: "We observed elevated latency due to a routing configuration change; we applied temporary limits and are rolling aggregation fixes. Expect <5% error reduction in next hour. Contact support if you see user-facing failures." Want PM sign-off.

frank_pm: SGTM, please include ETA: monitoring for next 30m and follow-up RCA within 72 hours. Add note about optional tenant-level bypass if correctness is required.

mike_oncall: limiter + aggregation patches are live. Storage RPS back down to ~1.1x baseline. Errors trending down.

alice_sre: running a correctness sweep on a sample of tenant prefixes flagged as high-risk — no signs of stale/inconsistent reads. Keeping bypass plan as rollback if paging reveals correctness faults.

ben_runtime: adding short-term telemetry rule to capture per-prefix fanout > 20 for 1m to detect regressions:
```
alert if sum(fanout) by prefix > 20 for 60s
```

mike_oncall: leaving oncall to ben and alice for next 2 hours for follow-through. I'm handing off — mike_out :wave: @darren_incidentbot please update incident status to mitigation_applied.

darren_incidentbot: STATUS UPDATE: mitigation_applied — route-level limiter + targeted aggregation re-enable applied. Incident severity downgraded to S2. Pager cleared for mike_oncall.

alice_sre: follow-up tasks: 1) full tenant impact report (emma + support), 2) roll back problematic change in rollout pipeline and add a canary test for fanout (ben), 3) RCA doc and playbook addition to avoid unbounded fanout in future (frank). Assigning owners.

emma_support: compiling customer list now, will post the draft to #customer-notify for review in 15m.

frank_pm: schedule RCA postmortem for tomorrow 10:00. Include infra, runtime, and product.

ben_runtime: temporary rules persisted. Will open PR for rollout guard and add unit/integration test to validate aggregated grouping before toggles.

mike_oncall: thanks all. keeping an eye on the alerts for the next hour, feel free to DM if anything pops back up. :white_check_mark:

darren_incidentbot: INCIDENT CLOSED -> monitoring. Final notes: cause = rollout of per-prefix grouping toggle without downstream fanout guards; mitigations = route-level fanout limiter + targeted aggregation; impact = transient elevated latency and increased 504s for ~35 minutes; customers notified (draft stage).
